items.good: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.ko: 내일 비가 오면 우리는 집에 있을 거예요.
bad: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rained tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will staying at home.

cz.st: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.

items.rule: 가능성이 있는 일은 if절에 현재시제를 쓰고, 주절에는 will + 동사원형을 써요. if절에는 미래를 나타내도 will을 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: If I were a bird, I would fly over the sea.
items.ko: 내가 새라면 바다 위를 날아갈 텐데요.
bad: If I would be a bird, I would fly over the sea.
If I were a bird, I will fly over the sea.
If I were a bird, I would flew over the sea.

cz.st: If I ___ a bird, I would fly over the sea.

items.rule: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정은 If + 과거형, 주절은 would + 동사원형이에요. be동사는 주어에 상관없이 were를 쓸 수 있어요.

items.good: If she studies hard, she will pass the test.
items.ko: 그녀가 열심히 공부하면 시험에 통과할 거예요.
bad: If she will study hard, she will pass the test.
If she studied hard, she will pass the test.
If she studies hard, she would passes the test.

cz.st: If she studies hard, she ___ pass the test.

items.rule: 가능성이 있는 조건문의 주절에는 will + 동사원형이 와요.

items.good: If I had a car, I would drive you to school.
items.ko: 내게 차가 있다면 너를 학교까지 태워다 줄 텐데요.
bad: If I would have a car, I would drive you to school.
If I had a car, I will drive you to school.
If I had a car, I would to drive you to school.

cz.st: If I ___ a car, I would drive you to school.

items.rule: 지금은 차가 없다는 사실과 반대되는 가정이므로 if절에 과거형 had를 써요.

items.good: If you heat ice, it melts.
bad: If you heat ice, it melt.
If you will heat ice, it melts.
If you heat ice, it melted.

cz.st: If you heat ice, it ___.

items.rule: 항상 사실인 일(과학적 사실)은 if절과 주절 모두 현재시제로 말해요. 주어 it은 3인칭 단수라서 melts예요.

items.good: What would you do if you won a million dollars?
bad: What will you do if you won a million dollars?
What would you do if you would win a million dollars?
What you would do if you won a million dollars?

cz.st: What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?

items.rule: 상상하는 질문은 What would you do if + 과거형 ~? 로 물어요. 의문문은 would가 주어 앞에 와요.

items.good: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
bad: If you won't hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you didn't hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you don't hurry, you will missing the bus.

cz.st: If you don't hurry, you will ___ the bus.

items.rule: will 뒤에는 동사원형을 써요. if절은 부정이어도 현재시제를 써요.

items.good: Unless you leave now, you will be late.
bad: Unless you don't leave now, you will be late.
Unless you will leave now, you will be late.
Unless you left now, you will be late.

cz.st: Unless you ___ now, you will be late.

items.rule: unless는 'if ~ not'(~하지 않으면)의 뜻이라서 이미 부정의 의미가 있어요. 그래서 뒤에 not을 또 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: If I were you, I would take an umbrella.
bad: If I am you, I will take an umbrella.
If I were you, I will take an umbrella.
If I were you, I would to take an umbrella.

cz.st: If I were you, I would ___ an umbrella.

items.rule: If I were you, I would ~ 는 상대에게 조언할 때 자주 쓰는 표현이고, would 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요.

items.good: I will go for a walk if the weather is nice.
bad: I will go for a walk if the weather will be nice.
I will go for a walk if the weather was nice.
I would go for a walks if the weather is nice.

cz.st: I will go for a walk if the weather ___ nice.

items.rule: if절이 뒤에 와도 규칙은 같아요. if절은 현재시제, 주절은 will + 동사원형이에요.

items.good: If we had more time, we would visit the museum.
items.ko: 시간이 더 있다면 우리는 박물관에 가 볼 텐데요.
bad: If we would have more time, we would visit the museum.
If we had more time, we will visit the museum.
If we had more time, we would visiting the museum.

cz.st: If we had more time, we ___ visit the museum.

items.rule: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정(If + 과거)의 주절에는 would + 동사원형을 써요.

items.good: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
bad: If you mix blue and yellow, you gets green.
If you mix blue and yellow, you getting green.
If you mixes blue and yellow, you get green.

cz.st: If you mix blue and yellow, you ___ green.

items.rule: 언제나 같은 결과가 나오는 사실은 if절과 주절 모두 현재시제를 써요. 주어 you에는 동사원형 get을 써요.

items.good: She would help us if she were free today.
items.ko: 그녀가 오늘 한가하다면 우리를 도와줄 텐데요.
bad: She will help us if she were free today.
She would help us if she would be free today.
She would helps us if she were free today.

cz.st: She would help us if she ___ free today.

items.rule: if절의 be동사는 가정할 때 were를 써요. 주어가 she여도 were를 쓸 수 있어요.

items.good: If you feel sick, tell your teacher.
bad: If you will feel sick, tell your teacher.
If you feels sick, tell your teacher.
If you feel sick, telling your teacher.

cz.st: If you ___ sick, tell your teacher.

items.rule: if절 + 명령문 형태도 가능해요. if절은 현재시제, 주절은 동사원형으로 시작하는 명령문이에요.

items.good: If you are tired, you should rest.
bad: If you will be tired, you should rest.
If you are tired, you should to rest.
If you are tired, you should rests.

cz.st: If you are tired, you should ___.

items.rule: 주절에 will 대신 should, can 같은 조동사를 쓸 수도 있어요. 조동사 뒤에는 항상 동사원형이 와요.

items.good: If I could fly, I would visit every country.
items.ko: 내가 날 수 있다면 모든 나라를 방문할 텐데요.
bad: If I would fly, I would visit every country.
If I could fly, I will visit every country.
If I could flying, I would visit every country.

cz.st: If I ___ fly, I would visit every country.

items.rule: 가정법 과거의 if절에는 can의 과거형 could를 쓸 수 있어요.

items.good: What will you do if it snows this weekend?
items.ko: 이번 주말에 눈이 오면 무엇을 할 거예요?
bad: What will you do if it will snow this weekend?
What would you do if it snows this weekend?
What you will do if it snows this weekend?

cz.st: What will you do if it ___ this weekend?

items.rule: 일어날 수 있는 일을 묻는 질문은 What will you do if + 현재시제 ~? 로 물어요.

items.good: If he studied more, he could get better grades.
items.ko: 그가 더 공부한다면 더 좋은 성적을 받을 수 있을 텐데요.
bad: If he studied more, he can get better grades.
If he study more, he could get better grades.
If he studied more, he could gets better grades.

cz.st: If he studied more, he ___ get better grades.

items.rule: If + 과거형으로 가정할 때 주절에는 would 외에 could(~할 수 있을 텐데)도 쓸 수 있어요.

items.good: If I weren't so tired, I would join you.
items.ko: 내가 이렇게 피곤하지 않다면 너와 함께할 텐데요.
bad: If I am not so tired, I will join you.
If I weren't so tired, I will join you.
If I weren't so tired, I would joined you.

cz.st: If I weren't so tired, I ___ join you.

items.rule: 부정의 가정도 If + 과거형(weren't)을 쓰고, 주절에는 would + 동사원형을 써요.

items.good: You can borrow my bike as long as you return it today.
items.ko: 오늘 돌려주기만 하면 내 자전거를 빌려 가도 돼요.
bad: You can borrow my bike as long as you will return it today.
You can borrow my bike as long as you returned it today.
You can borrow my bike as long as you returning it today.

cz.st: You can borrow my bike as long as you ___ it today.

items.rule: as long as는 '~하기만 하면'이라는 조건을 나타내요. 조건을 나타내는 절에서는 미래의 일도 현재시제로 써요.

items.good: I will call you when I arrive at the station.
bad: I will call you when I will arrive at the station.
I will call you when I arrived at the station.
I will call you when I arriving at the station.

cz.st: I will call you when I ___ at the station.

items.rule: when이 이끄는 시간 부사절에서도 미래의 일은 현재시제로 말해요. if절과 같은 규칙이에요.

items.good: I wish I had a dog.
bad: I wish I have a dog.
I wish I will have a dog.
I wish I having a dog.

cz.st: I wish I ___ a dog.

items.rule: I wish + 과거형은 현재 이루어지지 않은 소망(~라면 좋을 텐데)을 나타내요.

items.good: I wish I could speak French.
bad: I wish I can speak French.
I wish I could speaking French.
I wish I will speak French.

cz.st: I wish I ___ speak French.

items.rule: I wish 뒤에는 can 대신 could를 써서 '~할 수 있다면 좋겠다'는 소망을 말해요.

items.good: I wish it were Saturday today.
bad: I wish it is Saturday today.
I wish it will be Saturday today.
I wish it be Saturday today.

cz.st: I wish it ___ Saturday today.

items.rule: I wish 뒤의 be동사는 가정법에서 were를 써요. 사실과 다른 소망을 나타내요.

items.good: If you press this button, the door opens.
bad: If you press this button, the door open.
If you press this button, the door opening.
If you pressing this button, the door opens.

cz.st: If you press this button, the door ___.

items.rule: 기계나 규칙처럼 항상 같은 결과가 나올 때는 현재시제를 써요. the door는 3인칭 단수라서 opens예요.

items.good: If we leave early, we can catch the first train.
items.ko: 일찍 출발하면 첫 기차를 탈 수 있어요.
bad: If we will leave early, we can catch the first train.
If we left early, we can catch the first train.
If we leave early, we can catching the first train.

cz.st: If we ___ early, we can catch the first train.

items.rule: if절은 현재시제이고, 주절에는 can + 동사원형을 쓸 수 있어요.

items.good: If I won the singing contest, I would buy a new guitar.
items.ko: 노래 대회에서 우승한다면 새 기타를 살 텐데요.
bad: If I would win the singing contest, I would buy a new guitar.
If I won the singing contest, I will buy a new guitar.
If I won the singing contest, I would bought a new guitar.

cz.st: If I won the singing contest, I would ___ a new guitar.

items.rule: 가정법 과거에서 would 뒤에는 동사원형을 써요. 과거형은 if절에만 써요.

items.good: Would you be scared if you saw a ghost?
bad: Will you be scared if you saw a ghost?
Would you be scared if you would see a ghost?
Would you scared if you saw a ghost?

cz.st: Would you be scared if you ___ a ghost?

items.rule: Yes/No 질문도 Would you ~ if + 과거형 ~? 로 상상하는 상황을 물을 수 있어요.

items.good: If I didn't have homework, I would watch a movie.
bad: If I didn't had homework, I would watch a movie.
If I didn't have homework, I will watch a movie.
If I wouldn't have homework, I would watch a movie.

cz.st: If I didn't ___ homework, I would watch a movie.

items.rule: did not 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. 그래서 didn't had가 아니라 didn't have예요.

items.good: She will be happy if you visit her.
bad: She will be happy if you will visit her.
She will be happy if you visited her.
She will happy if you visit her.

cz.st: She will be happy if you ___ her.

items.rule: if절에는 미래의 의미라도 현재시제를 써요. will be happy처럼 주절은 will + be + 형용사예요.

items.good: If my brother were here, he would help us.
items.ko: 우리 형이 여기 있다면 우리를 도와줄 텐데요.
bad: If my brother will be here, he would help us.
If my brother were here, he will help us.
If my brother were here, he would helps us.

cz.st: If my brother ___ here, he would help us.

items.rule: 지금 여기에 없는 사람을 가정할 때는 If + 주어 + were를 써요.

items.good: Plants die if they don't get water.
bad: Plants dies if they don't get water.
Plants die if they doesn't get water.
Plants die if they don't gets water.

cz.st: Plants die if they don't ___ water.

items.rule: 일반적인 사실은 현재시제로 말해요. don't 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요.

items.good: If you eat too much candy, you will get a toothache.
items.ko: 사탕을 너무 많이 먹으면 이가 아플 거예요.
bad: If you will eat too much candy, you will get a toothache.
If you ate too much candy, you will get a toothache.
If you eat too much candy, you will to get a toothache.

cz.st: If you ___ too much candy, you will get a toothache.

items.rule: 충고나 경고를 할 때도 If + 현재, will + 동사원형을 써요.

items.good: If you saw a snake, what would you do?
bad: If you see a snakes, what would you do?
If you saw a snake, what will you do?
If you would see a snake, what would you do?

cz.st: If you ___ a snake, what would you do?

items.rule: if절이 앞에 오는 질문에서도 If + 과거형, would + 주어 + 동사원형 ~? 순서를 지켜요.

items.good: If the sun sets, it gets dark.
bad: If the sun sets, it get dark.
If the sun will set, it gets dark.
If the sun sets, it gotten dark.

cz.st: If the sun ___, it gets dark.

items.rule: 자연 현상처럼 늘 일어나는 일은 if절과 주절 모두 현재시제를 써요. the sun은 3인칭 단수라서 sets예요.

items.good: I would be nervous if I had to give a speech.
items.ko: 발표를 해야 한다면 나는 긴장될 텐데요.
bad: I would be nervous if I would have to give a speech.
I will be nervous if I had to give a speech.
I would nervous if I had to give a speech.

cz.st: I would be nervous if I ___ to give a speech.

items.rule: had to는 have to의 과거형으로, 가정법 과거의 if절에도 쓸 수 있어요.

items.good: If Mina keeps trying, she will win a medal.
items.ko: 미나가 계속 노력하면 메달을 딸 거예요.
bad: If Mina will keep trying, she will win a medal.
If Mina kept trying, she will win a medal.
If Mina keeps trying, she would wins a medal.

cz.st: If Mina keeps trying, she ___ win a medal.

items.rule: 앞으로 일어날 수 있는 결과를 말할 때 주절에 will을 써요.

items.good: If I lived near the sea, I would swim every morning.
items.ko: 바다 가까이 산다면 매일 아침 수영할 텐데요.
bad: If I would live near the sea, I would swim every morning.
If I lived near the sea, I will swim every morning.
If I lived near the sea, I would swimming every morning.

cz.st: If I ___ near the sea, I would swim every morning.

items.rule: 일반동사도 가정법 과거에서는 if절에 과거형을 써요(live → lived).

items.good: Don't open the window if it is too cold.
bad: Don't open the window if it will be too cold.
Don't to open the window if it is too cold.
Don't opens the window if it is too cold.

cz.st: Don't open the window if it ___ too cold.

items.rule: 부정 명령문 뒤에 if절을 붙일 수도 있어요. if절은 현재시제를 써요.

items.good: If the library is closed, we will study at the cafe.
items.ko: 도서관이 닫혀 있으면 우리는 카페에서 공부할 거예요.
bad: If the library will be closed, we will study at the cafe.
If the library is closed, we will studying at the cafe.
If the library closed is, we will study at the cafe.

cz.st: If the library ___ closed, we will study at the cafe.

items.rule: the library는 3인칭 단수라서 is를 써요. if절은 현재시제예요.

items.good: If I had a robot, it would clean my room.
items.ko: 내게 로봇이 있다면 그것이 내 방을 청소해 줄 텐데요.
bad: If I would have a robot, it would clean my room.
If I had a robot, it will clean my room.
If I had a robot, it would cleans my room.

cz.st: If I had a robot, it ___ clean my room.

items.rule: 주절의 주어가 바뀌어도(it) would 뒤에는 동사원형을 써요.

items.good: If you were me, what would you choose?
bad: If you will be me, what would you choose?
If you were me, what will you choose?
If you were me, what you would choose?

cz.st: If you ___ me, what would you choose?

items.rule: 상대방 입장이 되어 보는 가정은 If you were me ~ 로 말해요.

items.good: We will have a picnic unless it rains.
items.ko: 비가 오지 않는다면 우리는 소풍을 갈 거예요.
bad: We will have a picnic unless it doesn't rain.
We will have a picnic unless it will rain.
We have will a picnic unless it rains.

cz.st: We will have a picnic unless it ___.

items.rule: unless는 if ~ not의 뜻이고 현재시제와 함께 써요. 부정어 not은 같이 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: If I were the mayor, I would build more parks.
items.ko: 내가 시장이라면 공원을 더 많이 지을 텐데요.
bad: If I would be the mayor, I would build more parks.
If I were the mayor, I will build more parks.
If I were the mayor, I would building more parks.

cz.st: If I were the mayor, I would ___ more parks.

items.rule: 내가 될 수 없는 상황을 상상할 때 If I were ~, I would ~ 를 써요.

items.good: If you visit Jeju in spring, you will see yellow flowers.
items.ko: 봄에 제주에 가면 노란 꽃을 볼 수 있을 거예요.
bad: If you will visit Jeju in spring, you will see yellow flowers.
If you visited Jeju in spring, you will see yellow flowers.
If you visit Jeju in spring, you will saw yellow flowers.

cz.st: If you ___ Jeju in spring, you will see yellow flowers.

items.rule: if절에는 현재시제, 주절에는 will + 동사원형을 써요. 주절의 동사는 과거형으로 바꾸지 않아요.

items.good: If I knew her number, I would call her.
bad: If I would know her number, I would call her.
If I knew her number, I will call her.
If I knew her number, I would calling her.

cz.st: If I ___ her number, I would call her.

items.rule: know 같은 상태 동사도 가정법 과거에서는 if절에 과거형(knew)을 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If Ben ___ early, he will see the sunrise.
items.why: 가능성이 있는 일은 if절에 현재시제를 써요. 주어 Ben은 3인칭 단수라서 wakes up이에요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If I ___ a magic pen, I would draw a castle.
items.why: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정이므로 if절에 과거형 had를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
We ___ the football match if it doesn't rain on Saturday.
items.why: if절이 현재시제(doesn't rain)이면 주절은 will + 동사원형이에요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If I ___ you, I would talk to the teacher.
items.why: '내가 너라면'이라는 가정은 If I were you로 말해요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
Unless you ___ hard, you won't pass the test.
items.why: unless에는 이미 'not'의 뜻이 있어서 부정문을 따로 쓰지 않고 현재시제로 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If you freeze water, it ___ ice.
items.why: 항상 사실인 일은 현재시제로 말해요. it은 3인칭 단수라서 becomes예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If you don't water the plant, it ___.
items.why: if절이 현재시제이면 주절에는 will + 동사원형을 써서 앞으로의 결과를 말해요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
What would you do if you ___ a lost wallet on the street?
items.why: What would you do if ~? 에서 if절은 과거형을 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If Mia ___ more money, she would buy that bike.
items.why: 돈이 충분하지 않은 현재 상황과 반대되는 가정이므로 had를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
He would be angry if he ___ the truth.
items.why: would가 있는 주절과 짝이 되는 if절에는 과거형 knew를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If it ___ tomorrow, the soccer game will be postponed.
items.why: if절은 미래의 일도 현재시제로 써요. it은 3인칭 단수라서 rains예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If we ___ the bus, we'll be late for school.
items.why: we'll은 we will의 줄임말이에요. if절은 현재시제로 써요.

items.q: '네가 일찍 자면 내일 피곤하지 않을 거야.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: If you go to bed early, you wouldn't tired tomorrow.
If you go to bed early, you won't be tired tomorrow.
If you will go to bed early, you won't be tired tomorrow.
If you went to bed early, you won't be tired tomorrow.
items.why: 가능성이 있는 일이므로 If + 현재시제, will(won't) + 동사원형 순서예요.

items.q: '내가 지금 시간이 있다면 너를 도와줄 텐데.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: If I had time now, I would help you.
If I would have time now, I would help you.
If I had time now, I will help you.
If I had time now, I would to help you.
items.why: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정이므로 If + 과거, would + 동사원형이에요.

items.q: '열쇠를 잃어버리면 나에게 전화해.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: If you will lose your key, call me.
If you lost your key, calling me.
If you lose your key, to call me.
If you lose your key, call me.
items.why: if절은 현재시제이고 주절은 동사원형으로 시작하는 명령문이에요.

items.q: '날씨가 나쁘면 우리는 소풍을 가지 않을 거야.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: If the weather was bad, we won't go on a picnic.
If the weather is bad, we wouldn't going on a picnic.
If the weather is bad, we won't go on a picnic.
If the weather will be bad, we won't go on a picnic.
items.why: 가능성이 있는 조건은 if절을 현재시제로, 주절은 won't + 동사원형으로 써요.

items.q: '내가 너라면 그 영화는 안 볼 거야.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: If I were you, I won't watched that movie.
If I were you, I wouldn't watch that movie.
If I am you, I won't watch that movie.
If I were you, I wouldn't to watch that movie.
items.why: wouldn't 뒤에는 동사원형을 써요.

items.q: '네가 함께 가지 않으면 나는 가지 않을 거야.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: I won't go unless you come with me.
I won't go unless you don't come with me.
I don't go unless you will come with me.
I won't going unless you come with me.
items.why: unless 안에는 부정의 뜻이 들어 있어서 not을 또 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: '나에게 날개가 있으면 좋겠다.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: I wish I would have wings.
items.why: 현재 이루어지지 않은 소망은 I wish + 과거형으로 말해요.

items.q: 'If I were you, I would see a doctor.' 이 문장은 어떤 역할을 하나요?
items.why: If I were you, I would ~ 는 '내가 너라면 ~하겠다'라는 뜻으로 상대에게 조언할 때 써요.

items.q: 'If I lived on the moon, I would jump very high.'에 대한 설명으로 알맞은 것은?
o: 달에서는 항상 높이 뛴다는 사실을 말함
지금 달에 살지 않지만 상상해 보는 말
달에 살게 될 가능성이 높다는 말
어제 달에서 뛰어 본 경험을 말함
items.why: If + 과거형, would + 동사원형은 현재 사실과 반대되는 상상을 나타내요.

items.q: 'If it rains, I will stay home.'에서 말하는 사람은 비가 오는 것을 어떻게 생각하나요?
items.why: If + 현재, will + 동사원형은 앞으로 일어날 가능성이 있는 일을 나타내요.

items.q: Which sentence means the same as 'Unless you hurry, you'll be late.'?
o: If you hurry, you'll be late.
Because you hurry, you'll be late.
When you hurry, you'll be late.
If you don't hurry, you'll be late.
items.why: unless는 if ~ not과 같은 뜻이에요.

items.q: Which sentence means the same as 'If you don't wear a helmet, you can't ride this bike.'?
o: You can't ride this bike unless you don't wear a helmet.
You must not wear a helmet unless you ride this bike.
You can't ride this bike unless you wear a helmet.
You can ride this bike unless you wear a helmet.
items.why: if ~ not은 unless로 바꿀 수 있고, unless 뒤에는 긍정문을 써요.

items.q: In 'If I had a bike, I'd ride it to school.', what does I'd mean?
items.why: 가정법 과거의 주절에서 'd는 would의 줄임말이에요. had 뒤에는 동사원형이 올 수 없어요.

items.q: In 'She'd help you if she were free.', what does She'd mean?
items.why: if she were free가 가정이므로 She'd는 She would의 줄임말이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 실제로 일어날 가능성이 있는 일을 말하는 문장은?
o: If I were a king, I would make a new holiday.
If I had a time machine, I would visit dinosaurs.
If I could talk to animals, I would ask my dog.
If I find a wallet, I will take it to the police.
items.why: If + 현재시제, will + 동사원형은 가능성이 있는 일이고, If + 과거형, would + 동사원형은 상상이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 현재 사실과 반대되는 상상을 말하는 문장은?
o: If it is sunny, we will go outside.
If you press the bell, a nurse comes.
If I were a superhero, I would protect the city.
If I finish early, I will help you.
items.why: were와 would가 쓰인 문장은 현재 사실과 다른 상상을 나타내요.

items.q:
A: What would you do if you were the principal?
B: ___
o: I would make lunch time longer.
I'm going to school by bus.
items.why: What would you do if ~? 에는 상상해서 'I would ~'로 대답해요.

items.q:
A: Will you come to the party if it rains?
B: Yes, ___.
items.why: Will you ~?로 물었으니 Yes, I will.로 대답해요.

items.q:
A: Would you be happy if you won the prize?
B: Yes, ___.
items.why: Would you ~?로 물었으니 Yes, I would.로 대답해요.

items.q:
A: What will you do if you miss the last bus?
B: ___
o: I called a taxi last night.
items.why: 앞으로의 계획을 묻는 질문에는 'I'll(I will) ~'로 대답해요.

items.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분은?
If it will be sunny tomorrow, we will go hiking.
items.why: if절에는 미래의 일도 현재시제(If it is sunny)로 써요.

items.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분은?
If I would have a million won, I would buy a laptop.
items.why: if절에는 would를 쓰지 않고 과거형 had를 써요(If I had a million won).

items.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분은?
Unless you will hurry, you will miss the bus.
items.why: unless절도 if절처럼 현재시제를 써요(Unless you hurry).

items.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분은?
If you eat too much, you will getting fat.
items.why: will 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 해요(will get fat).

items.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분은?
If I am you, I would learn the guitar.
items.why: '내가 너라면'이라는 가정은 If I were you로 써요.

items.q:
가장 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
___, I would take a long nap.
o: If I didn't have school today
If I will not have school today
If I wouldn't have school today
If I not have school today
items.why: would가 있는 주절과 짝이 되는 if절은 과거형(didn't have)이에요.

items.q:
가장 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
___, you will feel better.
o: If you would take this medicine
items.why: 주절이 will이면 if절은 현재시제예요.

items.q:
가장 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
___, she would join the school band.
o: If she will play the flute
items.why: 주절이 would + 동사원형이면 if절은 과거형이에요.

items.q:
가장 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
If I could speak ten languages, ___.
o: I am traveling around the world
I would travel around the world
I travel around the world yesterday
I will traveled around the world
items.why: If I could ~ 와 짝이 되는 주절은 would + 동사원형이에요.

items.q:
as long as의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
You can stay here as long as you are quiet.
items.why: as long as는 '~하기만 하면, ~라면'이라는 조건을 나타내요.

items.q: unless와 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 표현은?
items.why: unless는 if ... not(~하지 않으면)과 같은 뜻이에요.

items.q: 'I wish I were taller.'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
items.why: I wish + 과거형은 지금과 다른 상황을 바라는 말이에요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
I wish I ___ a bigger room.
items.why: I wish 뒤에는 과거형을 써서 현재 이루어지지 않은 소망을 말해요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
I wish I ___ swim faster.
items.why: '더 빨리 헤엄칠 수 있으면 좋겠다'는 소망은 I wish I could ~ 로 말해요.

items.q: 상황: 나는 지금 돈이 부족해서 새 노트북을 살 수 없다. 이 상황을 바르게 말한 문장은?
o: If I have enough money, I would bought a new laptop.
If I had enough money, I will buy a new laptop.
If I would have enough money, I bought a new laptop.
If I had enough money, I would buy a new laptop.
items.why: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정은 If + 과거형, would + 동사원형이에요.

items.q: 상황: 내일 비가 올지도 모른다. 비가 오면 경기를 취소하겠다는 코치의 말로 알맞은 것은?
o: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the game.
If it rains tomorrow, we cancelled the game.
If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the game.
If it rained tomorrow, we will cancel the game.
items.why: 내일 일어날 수 있는 일이므로 If + 현재시제, will + 동사원형이에요.

items.q: 상황: 집이 좁아서 고양이를 키울 수 없다. 이 마음을 말한 문장은?
o: If my house would be bigger, I would keep a cat.
If my house were bigger, I would keep a cat.
If my house is bigger, I would kept a cat.
If my house were bigger, I will keep a cat.
items.why: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정은 If + were/과거형, would + 동사원형이에요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If you ___ the red button, the alarm rings.
items.why: 기계의 작동처럼 항상 같은 결과는 if절과 주절 모두 현재시제예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If you need help, just ___ me.
items.why: if절 뒤에 명령문이 오면 동사원형으로 시작해요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
Mom said, 'If you finish your homework, you ___ watch TV.'
items.why: 주절에는 may, can 같은 조동사 + 동사원형을 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If I were a doctor, I ___ sick people.
items.why: If I were ~ 와 짝이 되는 주절은 would + 동사원형이에요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
Tom would come to the party if he ___ sick.
items.why: 가정법 과거의 부정은 weren't를 써요(Tom은 지금 아파서 못 온다는 상황).

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
If you ___ a superpower, what would it be?
items.why: 상상 질문이므로 if절에 과거형 had를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
I'm sorry. If I ___ the answer, I would tell you.
items.why: 답을 모르는 현재 상황과 반대되는 가정이므로 knew를 써요.

items.title: An Email About the Weekend
items.text:
Hi Jina,
Thanks for your message! This weekend, my family is planning a trip to the lake. If the weather is nice on Saturday, we will rent a small boat and have lunch on the water. My little brother is excited, but he cannot swim well. Mom says he must wear a life jacket if he gets on the boat. If it rains, we will visit the science museum in town instead. I would love to go there, because I heard it has a huge model of the solar system. If you visited my town next year, I would take you to both places! Write back soon.
Your friend,
Ella

qs.q: Why is Ella writing this email?
o: To tell Jina about her weekend plans
To ask Jina for some help with her homework
To invite Jina to a birthday party
To say sorry for missing a trip
qs.why: Ella는 주말 계획을 이야기하며 친구에게 안부를 전하고 있어요.

qs.q: What will Ella's family do if it rains?
o: Rent a small boat and have lunch on the lake
Visit the science museum in town
Cook lunch at home all day
qs.why: 비가 오면 마을의 과학관에 간다고 했어요.

qs.q: Why must Ella's little brother wear a life jacket on the boat?
o: He is afraid of deep water.
qs.why: 동생은 수영을 잘하지 못해서 구명조끼를 입어야 해요.

qs.q: In the passage, the word 'huge' is closest in meaning to
qs.why: huge는 '아주 큰'이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Which statement is true according to the email?
o: Ella has already visited the lake this year.
Ella lives next to the science museum.
Ella's little brother will take Jina to the lake by boat.
Ella would show Jina both places if she came.
qs.why: 마지막 부분에서 Jina가 오면 두 곳 모두 데려가겠다고 했어요.

items.title: If I Were the Mayor
items.text: If I were the mayor of my town, I would make three changes. First, I would build more parks, because many children have nowhere safe to play. If there were more green spaces, families could spend more time together. Second, I would plant trees along every street. Trees give shade in summer, and they clean the air. Finally, I would keep the library open until nine o'clock. Many students study there after school, and some of them wish they had more time. Of course, a mayor needs a lot of money to do these things. But if people work together, I believe a small town can change a lot.

qs.q: What is the best title for the passage?
o: How a Mayor Spends His Money
The History of a Small Town
qs.why: 글쓴이가 시장이라면 하고 싶은 세 가지 변화를 이야기하고 있어요.

qs.q: What would the writer do about the library?
o: Build a second library near the park
Keep it open until nine o'clock
Move it closer to the bus stop
Sell some of the old books
qs.why: 도서관을 9시까지 열어 두겠다고 했어요.

qs.q: Why does the writer want more parks?
o: Families want to spend less time together.
Children lack safe places to play.
qs.why: 많은 아이들이 안전하게 놀 곳이 없기 때문이에요.

qs.q: In the passage, 'shade' is a place that is
qs.why: shade는 햇빛을 피할 수 있는 그늘이에요.

qs.q: What does the writer believe at the end?
o: Mayors never need any money to change a town.
Working together can improve a town.
qs.why: 마지막 문장에서 사람들이 함께 노력하면 작은 마을도 많이 바뀔 수 있다고 믿는다고 했어요.

items.title: Green Club Notice
items.text: The Green Club is looking for new members! We meet every Wednesday after school in Room 204. If you join us, you will learn how to sort trash and make useful things from old bottles. Last month, our members made pencil cases from plastic bags, and the teachers loved them. This year we also want to start a small garden behind the gym. If we get enough volunteers, we will begin planting in April. You do not need any experience. You can join as long as you like nature and want to help. If you are interested, please write your name on the paper outside Room 204 by Friday.

qs.q: Why was this notice written?
o: To announce a long school holiday in April
To invite students to join a club
qs.why: 새 회원을 모집하는 안내문이에요.

qs.q: When does the Green Club meet?
o: Every Monday during the lunch break
qs.why: 매주 수요일 방과 후에 모인다고 했어요.

qs.q: What will happen if enough students volunteer?
o: The club will start planting in April.
The club will move to a much bigger room.
The teachers will make pencil cases.
The gym will be painted again.
qs.why: 자원봉사자가 충분하면 4월에 심기를 시작한다고 했어요.

qs.q: Who can join the club?
o: Only members of the art club
qs.why: 경험은 필요 없고 자연을 좋아하면 가입할 수 있다고 했어요.

qs.q: In the passage, 'them' refers to
qs.why: 선생님들이 좋아한 것은 필통(the pencil cases)이에요.

items.title: A Rainy Saturday
items.text:
Saturday, March 9
Today was a boring day. It rained all morning, so I could not go to the park with my friends. I stayed in my room and read a comic book. I wish I had a pet to play with, but my apartment does not allow animals. If I had a dog, I would take it for a walk every evening, even in the rain. My sister says I am too lazy for a dog. Maybe she is right! If I can wake up early for a whole month, she will talk to Mom about it. Tomorrow I will start. I'll set my alarm for six thirty.

qs.q: How did the writer feel on Saturday?
qs.why: 첫 문장에서 지루한 하루였다고 했어요.

qs.q: Why can't the writer have a dog?
o: The sister is allergic to dogs.
The apartment does not allow animals.
Dogs are too expensive for the family to feed.
Mom does not like walks in the rain.
qs.why: 아파트에서 동물을 허락하지 않는다고 했어요.

qs.q: What will the sister probably do if the writer wakes up early for a month?
o: Take the dog for a long walk in the park
Give the writer a comic book
Set the alarm for the writer
Talk to Mom about getting a dog
qs.why: 한 달 동안 일찍 일어나면 언니가 엄마에게 이야기해 주겠다고 했어요.

qs.q: In the passage, 'allow' is closest in meaning to
qs.why: allow는 '허락하다'라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What does the writer plan to do tomorrow?
qs.why: 내일부터 일찍 일어나기를 시작하겠다고 했어요.

items.title: Easy Ways to Save Energy
items.text: Saving energy is not difficult. If you turn off the lights when you leave a room, you use less electricity. If you unplug your phone charger, it stops using power even when nothing is connected. Many families forget this simple step. Another good habit is to take shorter showers. If everyone in your house saves just five minutes a day, you will save a lot of water in a year. Finally, if you walk or ride a bike to school, you will make less pollution. Unless we change our daily habits, the planet will keep getting warmer. Small actions really do matter.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: Why phones and chargers use too much power
How small habits can help the planet
Which bike is best for school
qs.why: 일상의 작은 습관으로 에너지를 아낄 수 있다는 내용이에요.

qs.q: According to the passage, what happens if you unplug a phone charger?
qs.why: 충전기를 뽑으면 아무것도 연결되어 있지 않을 때 전력을 쓰지 않는다고 했어요.

qs.q: What will happen if everyone in a house saves five minutes of shower time a day?
o: They will save a lot of water in a year.
Their water bills will become double in a year.
The planet will cool down at once.
qs.why: 하루 5분씩 줄이면 1년에 많은 물을 절약한다고 했어요.

qs.q: In the passage, 'habit' means something people
qs.why: habit은 반복해서 하는 '습관'이에요.

qs.q: What does the writer want readers to do?
o: Change their daily habits a little
Stop using water and electricity completely
Wait for the government to act
qs.why: 작은 행동이 중요하니 일상 습관을 바꾸자는 것이 글쓴이의 메시지예요.

items.title: Ready for the Rain
items.text: Min-ho and his father planned a camping trip for the weekend. On Friday night, the sky was full of dark clouds. 'If it rains, the ground will be wet, and we will not be able to make a fire,' Father said. Min-ho looked worried. He had practiced setting up the tent for a week. 'Don't worry,' Father said with a smile. 'If we put the tent on higher ground, the water will not reach it. And if the fire does not work, we can cook noodles on the small gas stove.' On Saturday morning, it did rain a little, but they were ready. They ate hot noodles under a big tarp and listened to the rain. Min-ho decided that a bit of rain could not spoil the fun.

qs.q: Why was Min-ho worried on Friday night?
o: He forgot to bring the tent.
The camp site was too far away.
qs.why: 하늘에 먹구름이 가득해서 비가 올까 걱정했어요.

qs.q: What did Father suggest to keep the water away from the tent?
o: Put the tent on higher ground
Wrap the tent in a warm blanket tonight
Move the trip to next week
Dig a hole under the tent
qs.why: 텐트를 더 높은 곳에 치면 물이 닿지 않는다고 했어요.

qs.q: What can they do if the fire does not work?
o: Eat cold sandwiches and some fruit
Cook noodles on a gas stove
qs.why: 불이 안 되면 작은 가스버너로 국수를 끓일 수 있다고 했어요.

qs.q: How did Min-ho probably feel at the end?
qs.why: 비가 재미를 망칠 수 없다고 생각했으니 비가 와도 즐거웠을 거예요.

qs.q: In the last sentence, 'spoil' is closest in meaning to
qs.why: spoil the fun은 '재미를 망치다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.title: A Young Inventor
items.text:
Interviewer: You are only fifteen, and you have already made a robot that waters plants. How did you start?
Mia: I forgot to water my mother's flowers, and they died. I felt terrible, so I built a small machine. If the soil is dry, the machine sends water to the plant.
Interviewer: What would you do if you had more money?
Mia: I would make a bigger version for farms. Farmers lose many crops in dry summers. If they had my robot, they could save a lot of water.
Interviewer: What advice do you have for young inventors?
Mia: Don't be afraid to fail. If your first idea doesn't work, try again. I broke ten machines before this one worked.

qs.q: What is the interview mainly about?
o: A farmer who lost his crops
A young inventor and her plant robot
qs.why: 인터뷰는 식물에 물을 주는 로봇을 만든 젊은 발명가에 관한 이야기예요.

qs.q: Why did Mia build the machine?
o: She wanted to sell it to farmers.
qs.why: 어머니의 꽃이 죽은 일이 계기였어요.

qs.q: What would Mia do if she had more money?
o: Buy a farm for her mother and brother
Make a bigger machine for farms
qs.why: 더 많은 돈이 있다면 농장용 큰 버전을 만들겠다고 했어요.

qs.q: What does Mia mean by 'Don't be afraid to fail'?
qs.why: 실패를 두려워하지 말고 다시 시도하라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: How many machines did Mia break before one worked?
qs.why: 마지막 문장에서 열 대를 망가뜨렸다고 했어요.

items.title: Sunny Wheels Bike Shop
items.text: Summer is here, and Sunny Wheels has great deals for you! If you buy any bike this month, you will get a free water bottle. If you bring your old bike, we will give you a 10 percent discount on a new one. Do you worry about safety? Don't! If you buy a helmet with your bike, the helmet costs only half price. We are open every day from ten to six, but we are closed on Mondays. Not sure which bike to choose? Our friendly staff would be happy to help you. You can also try any bike for ten minutes unless the store is very busy. Come and find your perfect ride!

qs.q: Why was this advertisement written?
o: To teach people how to repair a bike
To advertise bikes and special offers
To invite people to a race
qs.why: 자전거 가게의 특별 행사를 알리는 광고예요.

qs.q: What will you get if you buy any bike this month?
qs.why: 이번 달에 자전거를 사면 무료 물병을 준다고 했어요.

qs.q: When is the shop closed?
qs.why: 월요일은 문을 닫는다고 했어요.

qs.q: In which situation might you not be able to test-ride a bike?
o: When you bring an old bike to us
When you choose a red bike
When the store is very busy
qs.why: 가게가 매우 붐비지 않는 한 10분간 타 볼 수 있다고 했으니 붐비면 어려울 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the passage, 'deals' is closest in meaning to
qs.why: deals는 싸게 살 수 있는 '특가, 거래 조건'이라는 뜻이에요.

items.title: Plants and Light
items.text: Have you ever left a plant in a dark closet? If a plant does not get enough light, it turns pale and grows weak. This happens because plants use sunlight to make their own food. We call this process photosynthesis. If the leaves receive light, water, and air, they produce sugar for the plant. Scientists also say that if a plant is placed near a window, it grows toward the light. If you turn the pot around, the plant will slowly bend the other way. This is why a houseplant needs a bright spot at home. Unless it gets light, even the strongest plant cannot survive for long.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
qs.why: 식물이 자라는 데 빛이 왜 필요한지를 설명하는 글이에요.

qs.q: What happens to a plant that does not get enough light?
o: It makes more sugar every day.
It turns pale and grows weak.
qs.why: 빛이 부족하면 창백해지고 약해진다고 했어요.

qs.q: What will happen if you turn the pot around?
o: The plant will slowly bend the other way.
The plant will stop growing for good this week.
The plant will turn bright red.
The plant will fall down at once.
qs.why: 화분을 돌리면 식물이 천천히 반대쪽으로 굽는다고 했어요.

qs.q: In the passage, 'process' means
qs.why: process는 여러 단계로 이루어진 '과정'이에요.

qs.q: In 'This happens because plants use sunlight...', what does 'This' refer to?
o: A plant turning pale and weak without light
A closet being too dark and nearly empty
qs.why: This는 앞 문장의 내용, 즉 빛이 부족해 식물이 창백해지고 약해지는 일을 가리켜요.

items.title: A Letter to a Tired Friend
items.text:
Dear Hana,
I'm sorry to hear that you feel tired every morning. Honestly, I think you stay up too late. If I were you, I would turn off my phone at ten o'clock and go to bed. When you sleep well, your brain works better, and you remember more at school. I had the same problem last year. When I played games until midnight, I could not wake up on time. Now I read a book for twenty minutes before bed, and I fall asleep easily. Try it for a week. If it doesn't help, you should talk to a doctor. I'll be happy to listen to your story anytime.
Your friend,
Soyun

qs.q: Why did Soyun write this letter?
o: To thank Hana for a gift
To invite Hana to a game
qs.why: 피곤해하는 친구에게 조언을 해 주려는 편지예요.

qs.q: What does Soyun do before bed now?
o: Reads a book for twenty minutes
qs.why: 지금은 자기 전에 20분 동안 책을 읽는다고 했어요.

qs.q: What does Soyun think is Hana's problem?
o: Hana goes to bed too late.
qs.why: Soyun은 Hana가 너무 늦게까지 깨어 있다고 생각해요.

qs.q: What should Hana do if the advice does not help?
qs.why: 도움이 되지 않으면 의사와 이야기하라고 했어요.

qs.q: What is Soyun's tone in the letter?
qs.why: 친구를 걱정하고 다정하게 조언하는 어조예요.

items.ex: You cannot enter the room unless you have a ticket.
items.exko: 표가 없으면 그 방에 들어갈 수 없어요.

items.ex: Can you imagine a world without cars?
items.exko: 자동차가 없는 세상을 상상할 수 있나요?

items.ex: You can borrow the book on one condition.
items.exko: 한 가지 조건으로 그 책을 빌릴 수 있어요.
